sections.heading: AI Features
items: Seed Audio 1.0: Generate music, multilingual speech, sound effects all in one model
Sonilo Music and Sound Effects: Create music and sound effects from a text prompt with Sonilo
More upscale controls: Many more video upscale options with ByteDance Upscaler and Topaz, including upscaling to 60 fps and 4k.
